name: io.github.yksanjo/trustmrr-mcp
title: TrustMRR Revenue
description: Look up verified revenue (MRR, 30-day, all-time) of any website listed on TrustMRR.

environmentVariables.name: TRUSTMRR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TrustMRR API key (get one at https://trustmrr.com/dashboard-dev)

environmentVariables.name: TRUSTMRR_INDEX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the domain index cache (default ~/.cache/trustmrr-mcp/domain-index.json)
